_comment: Deterministic BLOCKING rules for the pre-publish humanizer gate (.claude/hooks/humanizer-gate.mjs). Kept DELIBERATELY SMALL: a match hard-blocks a push, so only unambiguous, validated-low-false-positive tells live here. Everything else (title case, hype words, negative parallelism, decorative emoji, en-dash-as-em, etc.) is handled with judgment by the voice rewriting pass via .claude/skills/code-review/references/voice/ai-tells-catalog.md. Each rule below was validated against the real content corpus on 2026-07-13. Regexes are JS RegExp sources; \u escapes keep this file ASCII so it never flags itself. Optional per-rule 'dirs' narrows scope.

rules.message: Em-dash (U+2014) found. The flagship AI tell. Rewrite the sentence so no dash is needed (split into two sentences, or fold the aside into the main clause). Never swap it for a comma or an en-dash. (Note: en-dash in a numeric range like 9-5 is fine and is NOT flagged.)
Spaced double-hyphen ( -- ) used as an em-dash. Same interrupt-and-restate tell wearing a thinner mark. Rewrite so no dash is needed.

Curly/smart quote or apostrophe found in authored content. A paste-from-model fingerprint in a straight-quote repo. Normalize to straight ASCII (' and "). (Scoped to content/ only; rendering components may use typographic quotes deliberately.)
